Who will win this race? Betfair Non-Runner Rule applies. Reduction factors may be updated periodically at the discretion of Betfair based on trading in the market, but after approximately 5 minutes from scheduled ‘off’ time of a given race, they will be updated only in exceptional circumstances. Odds of matched bets will only be adjusted if there are ADDITIONAL non-runners after your bet is matched. This market will turn IN PLAY at the off with all unmatched bets cancelled once the Betfair SP reconciliation process has been completed. Betting will be suspended at the end of the race. This market will initially be settled on a First Past the Post basis. However we will re-settle all bets should the official result at the time of the "weigh-in" announcement differ from any initial settlement. Dead Heat rules apply.

BSP (Betfair Starting Price) operates on this market. For more information about setting a Starting Price odds limit click here

This is a cross-matching market.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns with an easy Townsville trial win to suggest he is forward enough for this. He was last seen leading and boxing on for third at Home Hill as a dominant odds-on favourite, after a wide run when sixth at Innisfail on heavy ground. His 13 wins and five places from 23 starts at this track and distance are hard to ignore, and the 3kg claim helps offset the 63kg. Outstanding track-and-distance record keeps him in the mix, provided the big weight does not tell.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns from a three-month break after finishing last in a Quality at this venue, beaten just under ten lengths when he led and faded after racing keenly early. That came only a week after he beat Yes Dream at this track as favourite, so his best 1000m form is still there, and five wins from eight at this track and distance is a strong pointer. A return to his prior win is required.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Worked home bravely for fourth in a BM70 at this track last week, beaten a length and a half after beginning slowly and striking interference near the home turn. That is solid form for this, and he gets clear weight relief from the 61.5kg carried there. He had won well at this venue on soft ground the run prior, beating Lucky Rolla by two and a half lengths, and the quick back-up suits. Weight relief and race fitness make him the one to beat.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns from a one-month freshening after a forgive run at Ewan, where he was sent out favourite but raced wide throughout, hung out and was beaten seven and a half lengths in a Quality. His previous third at Mackay in Class 6 grade was much stronger, leading and fighting hard when beaten a length and a half by Contemporary. His Mackay Class 6 third is the better guide and gives him solid place claims.

Strong track-and-distance record and weight relief make him a major winning chance.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Was second last in a BM70 at this track last week, beaten five and a half lengths at long odds after settling close enough and failing to finish off. His third to Hartshorn at this venue on soft ground two starts ago was sound enough in a small field, but he again meets that rival and has to turn around the latest result. Has track-and-distance form, but recent figures leave him looking stretched.
